paper_title: One Tokenizer To Rule Them All Emergent Language Plasticity via   Multilingual Tokenizers
caption: : Effect of vocabulary size.
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the relationship between vocabulary size and tokenizer accuracy. The x-axis is labeled “Tokenizer” and represents vocabulary size, using a linear scale ranging from 100k to 250k with tick labels at 100k, 175k and 250k. The y-axis is labeled "Accuracy (%)" and displays accuracy values on a linear scale ranging from 40.5 to 42.0. A solid navy blue line, marked with star symbols, begins at 40.6% at 100k, decreases to 41.2% at 175k and increases to 41.9% at 250k.  A solid orange line, marked with circular markers, starts at 41.6% at 100k, declines to 41.4% at 175k, and then increases to 41.8% at 250k.
